column1: # OpenABL releases: the SHA-256 of the first <size> bytes of an abl partition holding that release,
# from the release tarball (kettle-abl-update reads it). 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 are the Open Handheld
# Collective's (github.com/OpenHandheldCollective/OpenABL; v1.0's SM8550 .sha256 file is stale, so
# its row is the image's own hash), 1.0-kettle.1 Kettle's former fork (github.com/kettlelinux/OpenABL),
# kept so installs of it are recognised and updated.
